items.q: How can I request a quote?
items.a: Fill in the contact form, request a quote by email or call us. We will get back to you within 3 working days with an initial technical assessment.

items.q: Do you take on work across the country and abroad?
items.a: Yes. Our company takes on work anywhere in the country and abroad as well.

items.q: Is there an emergency call-out service?
items.a: Under an individual agreement, we provide a troubleshooting on-call service for customers with a maintenance contract, with a guaranteed call-out time.

items.q: Which platforms do you work with?
items.a: Software solutions for Siemens, SAIA, Qronox and Wago PLCs, EPLAN-based electrical design, WSCAD- and EPLAN-based 3D design, HMI programming and in-house SCADA integration, also adapted to existing systems.

bms.title: BMS

energiaellatas.desc: Design, installation and monitoring of complex power supply systems. Low- and medium-voltage transformers, distribution systems, switching and control equipment, uninterruptible power supplies, generator-set systems, as well as energy monitoring and consumption metering solutions, with EPLAN-based design, protection and control integration, and network modernization.

EPLAN design, protection and control integration

karbantartas.title: Maintenance
karbantartas.desc: Comprehensive preventive and corrective maintenance of BMS systems, power supply networks and electrical equipment. Inspection, diagnostics and repair of PLC, HMI and SCADA systems, switching and control cabinets, distribution equipment, uninterruptible power supplies and generator-set systems, with condition assessment, parts replacement and modernization.

scada.title: SCADA & process monitoring

title: Complete solutions
from the drawing board to commissioning.
head.lede: Since 2008 we have been designing, manufacturing and operating electrical and automation systems. From a small engineering office we have grown into a 15-strong team with our own equipment-manufacturing workshop, yet our attitude has not changed: we build every system as if it were our own.
head.heroPlaceholder: Photo, workshop / engineering team at work

story.title: From the drawing board to turnkey systems
paragraphs: Our company's story began in the field of rail-bound transport. For more than 15 years we have been providing control-systems and power-distribution solutions on MÁV, HÉV, BKV and SZKT projects.

Since 2023 we have also been actively present in building and industrial automation. Our work spans the full design and installation of BMS systems, power distribution for industrial facilities, electrical maintenance and inspections, and specialised electrical-installation work – including tasks carried out using rope-access and FAM technology.

valuesTitle.title: Four principles that guide every project

values.title: Safety above all
values.desc: Every system is built to standard, tested and documented, with no compromises.

values.title: Meeting deadlines
values.desc: In an industrial environment, downtime is money. We provide a realistic schedule and stick to it.

values.title: Transparent operation
values.desc: Full documentation, traceable decisions and clear communication in every phase of the project.

values.title: Long-term partnership
values.desc: We don't hand over a project – we hand over a working system, and we stay by your side throughout its entire operating life.

title: Build the critical
infrastructure with us!
head.lede: We're a team of electrical engineers, automation specialists and fitters who build the systems that keep cities, plants and utilities running. If you're looking for hands-on work too, this is your place.

intro.title: We don't develop office software — we build real systems.
paragraphs: Here the result of your work is tangible: a refurbished tram terminus, a production line that starts up flawlessly, a data centre running without interruption. From the drawing board to commissioning, you follow projects all the way through and watch them come to life.

We're a small-to-medium but strong engineering team where no one gets lost in the hierarchy. There's someone to learn from, there's responsibility, and there's room to grow — from junior fitter to senior project manager.

benefits.title: Real professional growth
benefits.desc: From low voltage to SCADA, from design to on-site commissioning — here you get to know the full spectrum, not just one narrow niche task.

benefits.title: Tangible projects
benefits.desc: Urban transport, energy, industrial plants, data centres. You work on systems that people use day in, day out.

benefits.title: Continuous training
benefits.desc: Manufacturer training and certifications: Siemens TIA Portal, Schneider, B&R, EPLAN. We invest in your development.

benefits.title: A strong engineering team
benefits.desc: A 15-strong, experienced team where sharing knowledge is the norm. Mentoring for entry-level colleagues, professional challenge for the experienced.

benefits.title: A solid foundation
benefits.desc: 15+ years, domestic and international references, predictable operations. No startup rollercoaster — a company built on solid ground.

benefits.title: Flexibility & fairness
benefits.desc: A hybrid work arrangement where the role allows, fair settlement of overtime and call-outs, quality tools and protective equipment.

values.title: Safety first
values.desc: In the electrical trade, safety is not a slogan. Standards-compliant work, training and discipline — for ourselves and for the client.

values.title: Precision
values.desc: A well-organised design and a clean cabinet pay off for years to come. We're proud of what we deliver.

values.title: Responsibility
values.desc: We stand behind what we hand over. When the client needs us, they can count on us.

values.title: Teamwork
values.desc: Designer, fitter and operator carry a project to success together. A good idea can come from anywhere.

villamos-tervezomernok.title: Electrical Design Engineer
villamos-tervezomernok.summary: Electrical design of low-voltage distribution and control systems in EPLAN, from concept to manufacturing documentation.
overview: Our design team is the heart of every project: this is where the plans for control cabinets, distribution boards and control systems are created, on which the workshop builds and the on-site team executes. You accompany the work all the way from the initial idea to the finished, production-ready documentation.
We work across many industries (transport, energy, manufacturing, data centres), so varied, technically demanding tasks await you, with real responsibility.
responsibilities: Electrical design of low-voltage distribution boards and control cabinets in EPLAN Electric P8
Preparing circuit diagrams, layout drawings, terminal-block and cable lists
Device selection, sizing and compliance with the relevant standards (IEC 61439, MSZ HD 60364)
Collaborating with manufacturing and the on-site team to ensure buildability
Maintaining documentation and managing revisions throughout the project lifecycle
requirements: Electrical engineering degree (BSc/MSc) or equivalent professional experience
At least 2–3 years of electrical design experience
Confident command of EPLAN Electric P8
Knowledge of low-voltage distribution and the relevant standards
Independent, precise way of working and good collaboration skills
niceToHave: Experience in transport or energy projects
offer: Varied, technically demanding projects with real responsibility
EPLAN and manufacturer training, certifications
Hybrid work arrangement, modern tools
A stable, predictable environment and a strong engineering team

plc-scada-mernok.title: PLC / SCADA Automation Engineer
plc-scada-mernok.summary: Programming, commissioning and integration of PLC and SCADA systems on production lines and utility infrastructure.
overview: In the automation team you build the "brains" of the systems: you write the PLC program, develop the HMI/SCADA interface and then bring the equipment to life on site. You see the task through from the drawing board to commissioning.
Thanks to your work, production lines, pumping stations and substations start up and run reliably, with tangible, immediately visible results.
responsibilities: PLC programming (Siemens TIA Portal, Schneider, B&R)
Developing and integrating HMI and SCADA interfaces
On-site commissioning, wiring checks, live start-up
Expanding existing systems, troubleshooting and optimisation
Documentation and training for the client's operators
requirements: Degree in electrical engineering / mechatronics or strong professional experience
At least 2 years of PLC programming experience (preferably Siemens TIA)

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy provides information on the processing of personal data by Debaru Kft. on the website and during contact, in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and the applicable Hungarian legislation.

body.p: The controller of the personal data:
When you fill in the contact form, we process the following data:

ul: Name (required), to identify the enquiry and to address you.
Company name (optional), to better understand the request.
The message text and any attached files, to assess the task.

body.p: In connection with the operation of the website, the system may also process technical data (e.g. IP address) in order to prevent abuse.

sections.title: Purpose and legal basis of the processing

body.p: The purpose of responding to the enquiry and of the professional consultation is to establish contact and to prepare a quotation.

Legal basis: the data subject's consent (Article 6(1)(a) GDPR), given by submitting the form and accepting the privacy policy; in the case of an intention to conclude a contract, the taking of steps prior to entering into a contract (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR).
On the basis of the legitimate interest in preventing abuse (spam, automated submissions) (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR), we use CAPTCHA protection.

We retain the data provided during contact for the purpose of responding to the enquiry or, if a cooperation is established, until its conclusion, and thereafter for the period required by legal obligations.
If no cooperation results from the enquiry, we erase the data within 12 months at the latest, or upon withdrawal of consent.
For the processing of the data, we use the services of the following data processors:

rows.label: Hosting / CDN
rows.value: Cloudflare, Inc. (101 Townsend St, San Francisco, CA 94107, USA)

body.p: We do not transfer the data to third parties beyond the above data processors and legal obligations, and we do not use them for marketing purposes.
The website uses cookies that are necessary for its operation. The CAPTCHA protection (Cloudflare Turnstile) may set a technical cookie / identifier to prevent abuse.
Cookies can be deleted or disabled at any time in the browser settings; however, this may limit the operation of certain functions.
Under the applicable legislation, you have the following rights in relation to your personal data:

ul: Access to the processed data and information about the processing.
Withdrawal of consent at any time, free of charge (the withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of the prior processing).

body.p: To exercise your rights, please write to info@debaru.hu.
We transmit the data over an encrypted connection (HTTPS) and protect it against unauthorised access, alteration and destruction by means of appropriate technical and organisational measures.
If you believe that our data processing infringes your rights, please contact us first. You may also lodge your complaint with the supervisory authority:

rows.label: Authority
rows.value: Hungarian National Authority for Data Protection and Freedom of Information (NAIH)

body.p: In the event of an infringement of your rights, you may also turn to a court.
